scope: Player, ordinary NPC and relation portraits only. No historical figure or TCG artwork.
sourceHeadContract: One alpha-isolated frontal head including hair, ears and long neck; no shoulder/body/clothes/background. Whole head contained. Same upper-left warm keylight, cool jade/umber shadows, readable eyes. Age changes preserve individual face identity.
style: Mature anime anatomical character design, painterly chiaroscuro, warm upper-left light/cool jade umber shadows, restrained earth colours. Generate smooth components first; PixelOE finish after composition. No glossy actor likeness or uniform heroic scowl.
runtimeIntegration: Asset authoring library; explicit runtime binding is documented separately and existing game assets are retained.
